overview: Phase 0b sensitivity gate (GO/NO-GO for using frozen pi0 flow-matching loss as a phrase-level reward). 250 BridgeV2 val contexts x ~92 phrases each (original + 3 arms: gemini_pro=gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gemini_flash=gemini-3.5-flash, qwen=Qwen3.5-9B base with thinking disabled; 32 rephrases/arm, deduped) x K=16 shared (eps, tau) draws (CRN), scored on both INTACT pi0 checkpoints on 1x RTX A6000. RESULT: GO. Median z-scored split-half Spearman ~0.95 across all arms and both checkpoints (signal share ~0.98); phrase-length/loss correlation ~0 (no length hack axis); discriminability flat-high for tau>=0.3 and collapses near tau=0 (clean-action end, lerobot convention: tau=1 is noise). Rephrase-FT checkpoint shows ~25% SMALLER phrase spread than plain checkpoint (paraphrase training increased invariance, as hypothesized). Oracle: best rephrase beats original instruction in 96-98% of contexts, median 31-33% relative loss reduction — large candidate-set headroom. Qwen arm spread within ~75-100% of Gemini arms -> no larger generator model needed for now.

Phase 0c: 1,290 SIMPLER episodes (4 Bridge tasks x ~33 phrases x 10 shared episode_ids, INTACT rephrase-FT pi0, in-process INT-ACT harness) + CRN flow-loss scoring of the same phrases on 50 matched real Bridge contexts (3 tasks; eggplant has no Bridge counterpart) + LLM-judge faithfulness pass. (A) IN-SIM [clean]: phrasing moves success strongly — carrot range 0.1-0.7 across 33 phrasings on identical initial states; success std 0.17-0.18 vs binomial floor ~0.15; failures interpretable (goal drift). Sim-canonical originals are strong (unlike offline 0b). (B) REWARD vs SUCCESS [caveated]: pooled rho=-0.10 (carrot -0.25, spoon -0.29, stack +0.21). Faithfulness pass explains it: 40% of Qwen-generated 0c phrases are goal-drifted; drifted phrases have LOWER mean flow loss (0.0794) than faithful (0.0948) yet lower sim success (0.40 vs 0.56) — the reward systematically PREFERS goal-drifted phrases (teacher-forced loss rewards trajectory-style fit; goal words barely change mid-episode action targets). Faithful-only subset: negatives vanish (carrot/spoon -0.09), pooled +0.20. CONSEQUENCE: confirmed reward-hacking axis -> Phase 2 must gate the reward on semantic faithfulness (advantage computed among faithful candidates only / drift penalized). Within-faithful, reward is weakly-positive-to-uninformative about sim success at n=10 precision; Phase 4 remains the behavioral test.

Step-0 A/B (inline vs Gemini-trace conditioning under CoVer verbatim template) + 0b-redo on the true training distributions. All three CoVer-template arms re-pass the reliability gate (rho 0.954-0.962 at K=16); oracle gain ~32% everywhere; trace==inline on judge-free axes -> interim primary conditioning = inline. Drift comparison pending credits. RL stack validated end-to-end to the gate (fail-closed checkpoint at step 0).

First RL run (flow reward, from base Qwen, beta=0.04 lr=1e-5 cps=2). Healthy to ~step 300 then KL runaway (0.31->2.0), parse-fail collapse by 465. Post-mortem: KL leash too weak. best_val@200 banked; used as INIT for both v2 arms.

Flow-reward arm of the flow-vs-L2 A/B. Init v1@200, beta=0.15, kl-abort 1.2, source-aug 0.5, cover35 traces, local-Qwen judge (Gemini interlude 07-10 reverted: thinking-token drain). lr 5e-6->1e-5->7e-6, cps 2->6. Probes every 10-25 steps. Best val margin +8.0% @300. RUNNING. ARCHIVED @ step ~690 (best_val@680, margin +7.9%); superseded by v3 from-scratch.

L2-reward arm: CRN decoded-action per-DoF-normalized L2 vs a*. Identical config to flow arm except --reward-mode l2 --k-l2 4. Best margin +3.1% @320 (best_val dir holds @100, raw-metric era). RUNNING. ARCHIVED @ step ~490 (best margin +3.1% @320); superseded by v3 from-scratch.

First deployment eval, nominal instructions, ep 0-9: original 50 / base 60 / tuned_flow@300 55 / tuned_l2@100 57.5 (%). Rephrasing helps; RL not yet past base; flow's carrot rename costs success (30 vs 40).

Red-team eval (CoVer ERT phrases verbatim, Gemini traces, ep 0-24 x1): direct 29 / base 51 / flow 47 / l2 43 (%). Stack: 0 -> 32 (tuned). Identical-phrase cells expose 8-16pp pi0 decoding noise -> x3 repeats mandatory.

Continuous red-team leaderboard on pod3: freshest best_val pair, tuned arms x3 x 25 states (600 eps/round); baselines topped to x3 once. One parquet per pair: rollouts_rt_f<step>_l<step>.parquet. RUNNING.

A/B RESTARTED FROM SCRATCH (base Qwen, NO v1 init — kills the flow-shaped-init confound) with the standard-order batch config: cps=6, G=32 candidates/context, grad accumulation over 4 groups (~670 sequences/optimizer update), GATELESS both arms (judge removed; drift watch via probes+evals), lr 7e-6, beta 0.15, kl-abort 1.2, source-aug 0.5, cover35 traces, per-stage timers. Flow arm pod1 (run_phase2.sh), L2 arm pod2 (run_pod_l2.sh). v2 checkpoints archived on-pod (*_v2_archive) and locally (results/checkpoints/phase2_v2_*_final).

Learned reward v1: MLP classifier P(instruction matches context) from pi0's BEHAVIORAL response only — raw flow velocities (v,u per CRN slot, K=8), decoded chunks (K=4), losses/grip/spread; NO text input, NO rephrases in training. Data: 2,000 Bridge train contexts x (own / hard-neg shared-token / easy-neg) from shard2 (verifier_features_train.parquet); val = 250 episode-disjoint contexts. Bridge val hard-negative AUC ~0.90-0.91 all modes; diff-block ablation: no-diff slightly better -> adopted. STUDY TRANSFER (never trained on SIMPLER or success labels): verifier_l2_nodiff pooled pairwise preference acc 0.818 (n=110 pairs, carrot+stack) vs best raw baseline grip 0.718, spread 0.664, -l2 0.627, -flow 0.264 (inverted). Carrot: pairwise 0.963, spearman_own 0.695, top-1 regret 1.0pp (near-oracle). Stack weaker (0.679). Relevance AUC 0.95-1.0; red-team phrases correctly ranked toward bottom. flow/both modes await study_verbose_flow.parquet (pod3 queue) for study eval. FULL 6-MODEL STUDY EVAL (2026-07-15, after verbose re-score): all six verifiers beat every raw baseline; l2_nodiff and both_nodiff tie at 0.818. KEY: flow-mode verifier hits 0.809 from the same draws whose scalar mean scores 0.264 — the raw velocity VECTORS carry correct ranking signal that MSE aggregation inverts. Diff ablation mode-dependent (helps flow, hurts l2). Provisional training-reward pick: verifier_both_nodiff (tied best, two feature families hedge Goodhart, +20% reward cost vs l2-only); confirm with spoon+eggplant labels.

overview: Multi-frame verifier eval on 250 held-out Bridge val episodes x 4 quartile frames (shard4 concurrent session). Locked ensemble, episode-level decisions: 1 frame (best=q1) AUC 0.945/hard 0.914/acc 0.872 -> 2 frames 0.969/0.946/0.897 -> 4 frames 0.976/0.958/0.916. Hard-negative AUC-error nearly HALVED by 4 frames. Calibrated log-product == flat mean (0.9761 vs 0.9760) — user's independence-product aggregation validated as equivalent post-calibration. Early frames individually strongest (q1 0.914 vs mid 0.86-0.88 hard) but mid frames complementary. +hist RETIRED: +0.002 even at mid-episode frames. DECISION: adopt 4-frame training reward (+~24%% step time, update-dominated steps) at next checkpoint boundary of both A/B arms.

FULL spoon labels (5,472 eps, 19 phrases) update the 3-task scorer table: locked ensemble pooled pairwise DROPS to 0.66 (spoon inverts: 0.206 pairwise, spearman -0.35 on own-16) while raw grip rises to 0.75 pooled — the partial-spoon 'noise' hypothesis is dead; the ensemble genuinely misranks spoon's mid-field. Mitigating: ensemble top-1 regret stays excellent on ALL tasks (1.7/5.2/4.9pp) — its best-pick is near-oracle even on spoon — and relevance/RT metrics remain strong (0.97 AUC, RT rank 16/18). DECISION: no mid-night reward thrash; the pre-registered decision table is the 4-frame multi-t study eval + eggplant sim-grounded column (in flight on shard4). If that confirms mid-pack ranking, revisit reward (grip-aware retrain) with a from-scratch A/B restart per the no-divergence policy. ALSO: pull the first tier-2 SIM rollout checkpoint eval EARLIER (~first best_val) — the dual-curve tripwire is the real guard while the reward's fine-ranking is in question.

DECISION TABLE (study multit, full spoon labels): the spoon inversion was a CONTEXT artifact — on fresh quartile-sampled contexts the locked ensemble scores pooled pairwise 0.903 (1 early frame) / 0.917 (2f) / 0.868 (4f = the live training reward) vs 0.66 on the old single-frame contexts; spoon 0.206 -> 0.882; carrot 1.000 (54 pairs); grip dethroned (0.875 at 4f, weaker than ensemble on spoon). Early frames carry the signal (matches Bridge-val q1 dominance). 2f edges 4f study-side (~1 SE, n=144) while Bridge-val (n=750) says 4f>2f — HOLDING 4-frame training reward; 2f is the challenger if eggplant sim column splits the tie. The 4am grip-scare entry is superseded.

Eggplant sim-grounded eval (60 recorded trajectories, 2,100 feature rows; full 5,472-ep labels, success 30-97%): locked ensemble INVERTS fine ranking (pairwise 0.172, spearman -0.555) while keeping coarse judgment (relevance AUC 0.996, top-1 regret 6.2pp); raw grip scores a PERFECT 1.0 pairwise. Interpretation: leave-task-out is confounded with leave-DOMAIN-out — these are the only SIM-rendered scoring images, and the learned readout misreads pi0's responses to sim visuals while raw physical-error metrics survive the shift. SCOPE: the training reward runs on REAL Bridge frames where it is validated (0.87-0.92 pooled pairwise, multit contexts); no training change. Any future SIM-side verifier use needs grip/raw hybrids or sim-domain adaptation.

Both arms migrated A40->L40S with full checkpoint continuity (frozen step 75). First verified L40S step: 273.8s total (gen 55.8 / score 69.4 / update 148.4) = 1.9x the A40's 515s. Backward-stall RESOLVED: bwd 187->86s, ratio 4.6x->1.5x of fwd — PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True (deployed via bootstrap) was the fix for the allocator fragmentation stalls; L40S compute uplift covers the rest. ~310 steps/day/arm. Retained step_NNNN snapshots every 20 steps from ~80. A40s converted: A40-1 battery host, A40-2 baseline-comparison roll + arm-B val pod.

v5 A/B ENDED by KL circuit breaker (rolling KL > 1.2): arm A step 279, arm B step 268. Nominal-input greedy reward: A -0.19->+0.22, B -0.35->+0.54 (originals +0.58). ERT-input greedy flat/declining (A -1.68->-1.88, B ~-1.4 = frozen level); mechanism: copy-drift (A input-echo, Jaccard 0.42->0.51) + input-proximity Goodhart; ERT x12 evals in val_screens/. All checkpoints archived (Mac adapter_archive, 24 entries incl finals+best_val).

v6 A/B FROM SCRATCH: native-4f 5-seed calibrated ensemble reward (verifier_reward_ensemble_4f.json), tiered inputs 25% nominal / 25% benign / 50% hostile-ERT (ert_train_sources 4,708 truncation-free across 3 styles incl short CoVer register; tier-matched ERT-derived traces 4,708), conditioning consistency (generation and p_single update share the source, both arms), ckpt dir phase2_v6, val+snapshots every 20, greedy + ERT-greedy val probes live. Success criteria pre-registered in EXPERIMENT.md.

Tiers per task: original 10 trials (init states 0-9); 5 naturals x 5 trials + 5 adversarials x 5 trials (inits 0-4, paired), phrases from the phrase-rl tier prompt (prompts/rules_loop/generate.md verbatim, text-only, gemini-pro-latest, temp 0.9). Oracle = rollout board search, faithful port of scripts/search_boards.py (board 16 incl canonical + 5 naturals, screen 5 trials on inits 0-4 (AMENDED from 3 mid-run, user 2026-08-25, before any l90 board ran; the single completed 3-trial board — libero_goal task 6, saturated round 1, winner=canonical 10/10 confirm — is grandfathered; canonical+naturals screen free via tier-episode reuse), keep-4, informed regen by gemini-3.5-flash image-conditioned on the task's init-state agentview frame, converge when best screen score stops improving or top-4 saturate, max 4 rounds), then confirm top-4 + canonical at 10 trials on VIRGIN inits 20-29 (winner's-curse guard; sealed-oracle protocol: select 0-17 / estimate virgin 18-23). overview:
V2 rulebook study: THREE one-shot rulebooks distilled by a Fable ultracode panel (3 lens-distillers -> adversarial critic -> synthesizer per arm; 15 agents, 1.28M tokens, no iterative loop), differing ONLY in evidence diet: (T) train-only = 4,544 gripper-proxy phrases over 220 tasks + corpus statistics + mining artifacts, with val8/sim and sealed tasks excluded and gt columns stripped (critic ran a leakage check); (S) rollout-only = the 516 real-rollout bank rows over the 8 sim tasks, black-box-VLA framing, no corpus artifacts (critic ran an overfit check); (B) combined = full 5,236-row bank + all corpus artifacts. Each book applied by ALL THREE appliers (claude-fable-5 effort high / gemini-pro-latest thinking 1024 temp 0 / Qwen3.5-9B greedy pod-side) via the loop apply.md wrap over text scene traces (no applier sees the image), on the sealed 12-task suite in three conditions: adversarial (72 attacks = original 12 + 60 NEW from the held-out ERT generator, 24 layouts x 2), natural (12x16 rephrases, MATCHED traces fixing the paper's ERT-derived-trace defect, 24 layouts), original (12 nominals, 24 layouts x 2). Same-protocol no-rules scaffold controls measured for adversarial and natural. ~62k episodes, 797 sharded rollout legs, 16 render pods, zero failures.

RESULT (sealed success %, claude/gemini/qwen): train-only adv 26.9/27.6/27.3, nat 29.0/28.6/30.3, orig 36.5/37.5/38.0; rollout-only adv 30.7/30.4/28.4, nat 32.4/32.7/31.7, orig 39.2/38.9/28.5; combined adv 29.2/30.0/26.7, nat 29.1/29.1/31.7, orig 39.6/39.9/37.0; no-rules scaffold adv 24.3/24.0/24.7, nat 30.2/31.1/30.0. Baselines: un-rephrased adv 24.5, nat 28.45, orig 36.1.

CONCLUSIONS: (1) rollout evidence is the active ingredient -- the rollout-only book wins 7/9 cells and is the only arm with a large adversarial gain (+4 to +6pp over a no-rules floor that sits AT the un-rephrased baseline, i.e. no-rules rephrasing does nothing for attacks); (2) train-only (proxy + corpus statistics, no rollouts) is inert -- every cell within ~2pp of baseline and BELOW the no-rules control on naturals; (3) combining dilutes the rollout signal except on originals, where its conservatism gives the best cells in that column; (4) one harm case: qwen x rollout-only x original 28.5 vs 36.1 baseline -- a 9B applier over-edits already-clean instructions.
